dataList.name: Focused Attack
dataList.desc:
Ketika memakai Skill terhadap the same Slot unit ini successfully hit giliran sebelumnya, peroleh efek berikut berdasarkan jumlah dari consecutive giliran it successfully hit the Slot
- 1 Consecutive hit: Clash Power +1
- 2 Consecutive hits: Base Power +1
- 3 Consecutive hits: Base Power +1, Coin Power +1

dataList.name: Focused Attack - Meursault
dataList.desc:
<Pertempuran Terfokus Only>
Unit that diberikan this Focused Attack peroleh efek berikut based pada target Slot's Focused Attack Stack.
  · 1x Stack: Peroleh Clash Power +1
  · 2x Stack: Peroleh Base Power +1
  · 3x Stack: Peroleh Base Power +1 dan Coin Power +1
- Kadaluarsa jika, for a giliran, unit that diberikan it fails to hit the Slot diberikan dengan their Focused Attack.
- Kadaluarsa jika unit that diberikan Focused Attack memberi it on a different Slot.
- Digantikan jika a different unit memberi Focused Attack on a Slot sudah diberikan dengan Focused Attack.
- Pada awal dari giliran berikutnya, jika a Slot diberikan dengan Focused Attack is no longer present, rearrange semua Focused Attack diberikan terhadap the Slots of that Bagian in the order of Deployment
